name: Beat Section (Emotional-Beat Chrome)
when_to_pick: Render a full article section whose chrome itself encodes the section's emotional beat — a colored left rail, a labeled beat tag with an icon, and a variant-specific callout — so a scanning reader instantly feels whether they are hearing about a problem, a complication, partial progress, the essential answer, or a call to act. Reach for this when a section's narrative role matters as much as its text and you want the surface to carry that role. Pick the variant by beat: 'problem_named' for an opening or stakes-naming section (red rail + a single hard stat callout); 'tension_rises' for a mid-article 'yes but' complication (amber rail + a bold pull-quote); 'partial_resolution' for one step of a multi-step methodology (accent rail + a step-progress bar and a 3-up workflow strip); 'full_payoff' for the section that delivers the article's essential answer (green frame + a result/metric answer card); 'next_action' for a closing or 'do this now' section (accent frame + numbered steps and a CTA). Use a plain callout component instead when the section carries no narrative-beat meaning.

variant.description: Emotional beat of the section. Drives rail color, icon, beat-tag color and which optional callout fields are read. problem_named=red rail, tension_rises=amber rail, partial_resolution=accent rail, full_payoff=green frame, next_action=accent frame.

beat_label.description: Short uppercase-styled tag shown next to the beat icon, e.g. 'The problem', 'Complication', 'Progress', 'The answer', 'Do this next'.

body.description: Main section prose. Trusted inline HTML — rendered with |safe so it may contain <strong>, <em>, <code> and <a>. Do not include block-level or script markup.

hook.description: Optional closing transition line, shown italic above a dashed divider with a returning-arrow glyph. Used to pull the reader into the next section.

stat.description: Optional — problem_named only. A single hard stat callout: a mono value plus a short descriptive label.

value.description: The number/stat, e.g. '180ms'. Rendered mono and colored.

label.description: What the stat measures, e.g. 'median latency we measured during NYSE open'.

pullquote.description: Optional — tension_rises only. A bold italic pull-quote that crystallizes the complication.

progress.description: Optional — partial_resolution only. Step-progress indicator above the heading.

percent.description: Fill percentage of the progress bar (0-100).

workflow.description: Optional — partial_resolution only. A 3-up (or fewer) workflow strip; exactly one step may be marked active and following steps render as upcoming.

state.description: Visual state of the step. 'active' is highlighted, 'upcoming' is dimmed, 'done' is neutral.

answer_card.description: Optional — full_payoff only. The crystallized-answer result card with an optional right-aligned metric.

meta.description: Optional supporting line under the answer, e.g. '14 bots, 6 brokers, 180-day live test'.

value.description: Metric value, e.g. '9ms'. Rendered large + mono.

label.description: Metric label, e.g. '95th percentile, real users'.

steps.description: Optional — next_action only. Numbered action steps; each has a bold title and a small detail line.

title.description: The step's action, e.g. 'Ping your broker's order endpoint 60 times'.

detail.description: Optional detail line under the step. Trusted inline HTML — rendered with |safe so it may contain <code> and <em>.

cta.description: Optional — next_action only. The closing call-to-action button.

href.description: Destination URL or in-page anchor for the CTA.
